reason: Provides agent-controlled browser automation with visible navigation, interaction, screenshots, user-mediated login, and persistent browser state.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供可视化且持久化的浏览器自动化工具，支持网页导航、交互、截图以及由用户完成的登录流程。
summaries.en: Provides agents with a visible persistent browser for web navigation, interaction, screenshots, and user-completed login flows.

capabilities: Launches and controls a visible browser
Navigates websites and reads page content
Clicks, types non-password text, selects controls, scrolls, manages tabs, and uploads files
Persists browser cookies, localStorage, and login state in a profile
Captures screenshots and optionally sends visual page data to a configured local vision model
Supports user-completed login flows in a visible browser window
